##### Project general facts

Ethan by Griffin is a boutique residential address set within the prestigious Nad Al Sheba district, where contemporary architecture meets a calm, resort-inspired atmosphere. The mid-rise structure, defined by clean lines and refined proportions, is thoughtfully designed to balance privacy with openness. A limited collection of one- and two-bedroom residences is carefully planned to maximize space, natural light, and everyday functionality, creating homes that feel both modern and inviting in the heart of the city.

The lifestyle at Ethan by Griffin is shaped by a curated selection of amenities that support both relaxation and connection. Residents enjoy adult and children’s swimming pools, a fully equipped fitness club, and dedicated play areas, all complemented by elegant indoor lounges and landscaped outdoor terraces. A welcoming lobby with reception and 24/7 security ensures comfort and peace of mind, while thoughtfully designed communal spaces encourage a sense of community within a serene environment.

Interiors are finished with a focus on comfort and contemporary elegance, featuring high-quality materials, soft neutral palettes, and smart home systems that enhance daily living. Fully furnished residences offer well-integrated layouts with stylish fittings, modern kitchens equipped with appliances, and carefully selected finishes throughout, delivering a turnkey living experience that combines practicality with refined design.

##### Location description and benefits

Nad Al Sheba is a prestigious residential district located just minutes from the heart of Dubai, known for its quiet atmosphere, spacious communities, and proximity to key landmarks. Positioned near Meydan and the iconic Meydan Racecourse, the area offers a unique blend of exclusivity and accessibility. Residents benefit from quick connections to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and major highways, making daily commuting smooth and efficient.

The district is characterized by low-density developments, villas, and boutique residential projects, creating a calm and private environment away from the city’s density. Nad Al Sheba is also home to green open spaces, cycling tracks, and leisure facilities, appealing to those who value an active and balanced lifestyle. Nearby schools, healthcare centers, and retail options ensure everyday convenience within a short drive.

Despite its tranquil setting, Nad Al Sheba remains closely connected to Dubai’s vibrant core. Key destinations such as Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport are easily accessible, allowing residents to enjoy both peaceful suburban living and the energy of the city. This balance makes Nad Al Sheba an increasingly sought-after location for families and professionals seeking comfort, space, and connectivity.
